more",hygienePlusFullDescriptionMarkdown:'<div class="bcard-terms-txt">\n  <p>To help our travelers make informed and safe travel decisions, Agoda has initiated Hygiene Plus. Our partners listed under this campaign are committed to providing a clean environment to guests and staff by enhancing safety and hygiene measures. These partners have confirmed their compliance with specific safety and hygiene measures and can update their list at any time – providing you with up-to-date information to help you make the most informed choice.<\/p>\n<p>Hygiene Plus is not a guarantee from Agoda that any accommodation is risk-free. We rely on properties to affirm their own safety measures and amenities. As a traveler it is your responsibility to follow government advice, enforce personal hygiene measures, and apply social and physical distancing during your stay. The high tea was excellent and definitely one of the highlights. It was quite elaborate and felt more like a mini buffet than a typical high tea.

I also want to specifically appreciate Sri Lakshmi and Sachin for the cake arrangement, and Sujit for his service in the dining area. Their efforts stood out and made our experience better.

The pool was a good experience, especially with the small fountain, and the beach deck and lawn are well maintained and add to the overall ambience. Cleanliness was very good throughout our stay, and service was generally quick and responsive.

The high tea was excellent and definitely one of the highlights. It was quite elaborate and felt more like a mini buffet than a typical high tea.

I also want to specifically appreciate Sri Lakshmi and Sachin for the cake arrangement, and Sujit for his service in the dining area. Their efforts stood out and made our experience better.

There were a few issues during our stay that we had to bring to the team's attention. To their credit, once we raised our concerns, the response was good and we saw a noticeable improvement in the experience. I appreciate the way the team took the feedback and acted on it.

That said, some of these issues ideally should have been identified and addressed before a guest had to raise them. If one guest encounters a problem, there is a good chance someone else may have experienced something similar before. For a luxury property, I would expect that feedback to translate into fixing the underlying issue so that the next guest doesn't face the same problem.

The biggest area that needs improvement is the food variety, particularly the breakfast buffet. The spread felt quite limited compared with what we have experienced at other luxury resorts in this category. Given the positioning and pricing of the property, I expected a much wider selection. Kaldan Samudhra PalaceResponded June 15, 2026Kaldan Samudhra Palace, a Palace by the SeaDid you find this review helpful?YesNo8.8ExcellentPadmanabhan from IndiaCoupleDeluxe King Pool FacingStayed 1 night in August 2026“Beautiful Property and Great Service, With Some Room for Improvement”Kaldan Samudhra has a lot going for it, particularly the property, cleanliness, outdoor spaces, and service.

The pool was a good experience, especially with the small fountain, and the beach deck and lawn are well maintained and add to the overall ambience. Cleanliness was very good throughout our stay, and service was generally quick and responsive.

The high tea was excellent and definitely one of the highlights. It was quite elaborate and felt more like a mini buffet than a typical high tea.

I also want to specifically appreciate Sri Lakshmi and Sachin for the cake arrangement, and Sujit for his service in the dining area. Their efforts stood out and made our experience better.

There were a few issues during our stay that we had to bring to the team's attention. To their credit, once we raised our concerns, the response was good and we saw a noticeable improvement in the experience. I appreciate the way the team took the feedback and acted on it.

That said, some of these issues ideally should have been identified and addressed before a guest had to raise them. If one guest encounters a problem, there is a good chance someone else may have experienced something similar before. For a luxury property, I would expect that feedback to translate into fixing the underlying issue so that the next guest doesn't face the same problem.

The biggest area that needs improvement is the food variety, particularly the breakfast buffet. The spread felt quite limited compared with what we have experienced at other luxury resorts in this category. Given the positioning and pricing of the property, I expected a much wider selection. The food options in general could benefit from more variety.

Overall, Kaldan Samudhra is a beautiful and well-maintained property with a good pool, enjoyable outdoor spaces, excellent high tea, and some genuinely good people providing service. I would recommend the property, but I hope the management takes the feedback seriously, particularly around food variety and consistency. Addressing these areas would make the overall experience much more in line with what guests would expect from a luxury resort.Reviewed August 05, 2026Dear Padmanabhan,

We genuinely value your feedback regarding the areas for improvement, particularly concerning food variety and the breakfast buffet. It's great to know that our team responded positively to your concerns, and we will certainly keep your insights in mind to enhance our guest experience further. Your recommendation means a lot to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for an even better stay in the future!

Kaldan Samudhra PalaceResponded September 02, 2026Kaldan Samudhra Palace, a Palace by the SeaDid you find this review helpful?YesNo8.8ExcellentPadmanabhan from IndiaCoupleDeluxe King Pool FacingStayed 1 night in August 2026“Beautiful Property and Great Service, With Some Room for Improvement”Kaldan Samudhra has a lot going for it, particularly the property, cleanliness, outdoor spaces, and service.

The pool was a good experience, especially with the small fountain, and the beach deck and lawn are well maintained and add to the overall ambience. Cleanliness was very good throughout our stay, and service was generally quick and responsive.

The high tea was excellent and definitely one of the highlights. It was quite elaborate and felt more like a mini buffet than a typical high tea.

I also want to specifically appreciate Sri Lakshmi and Sachin for the cake arrangement, and Sujit for his service in the dining area. Their efforts stood out and made our experience better.

There were a few issues during our stay that we had to bring to the team's attention. To their credit, once we raised our concerns, the response was good and we saw a noticeable improvement in the experience. I appreciate the way the team took the feedback and acted on it.

That said, some of these issues ideally should have been identified and addressed before a guest had to raise them. If one guest encounters a problem, there is a good chance someone else may have experienced something similar before. For a luxury property, I would expect that feedback to translate into fixing the underlying issue so that the next guest doesn't face the same problem.

The biggest area that needs improvement is the food variety, particularly the breakfast buffet. The spread felt quite limited compared with what we have experienced at other luxury resorts in this category. Given the positioning and pricing of the property, I expected a much wider selection. The food options in general could benefit from more variety.

Overall, Kaldan Samudhra is a beautiful and well-maintained property with a good pool, enjoyable outdoor spaces, excellent high tea, and some genuinely good people providing service. I would recommend the property, but I hope the management takes the feedback seriously, particularly around food variety and consistency. Addressing these areas would make the overall experience much more in line with what guests would expect from a luxury resort.Reviewed August 05, 2026Dear Padmanabhan,
Thank you for sharing such a detailed and thoughtful review! It's wonderful to hear that you enjoyed the beauty of Kaldan Samudhra Palace, as well as our cleanliness, outdoor spaces, and service. We're delighted that high tea stood out as a highlight for you, and we appreciate your kind words for Sri Lakshmi, Sachin, and Sujit.

We genuinely value your feedback regarding the areas for improvement, particularly concerning food variety and the breakfast buffet. It's great to know that our team responded positively to your concerns, and we will certainly keep your insights in mind to enhance our guest experience further. Your recommendation means a lot to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for an even better stay in the future!

Best Regards,

For a luxury property, I would expect that feedback to translate into fixing the underlying issue so that the next guest doesn't face the same problem.

The biggest area that needs improvement is the food variety, particularly the breakfast buffet. The spread felt quite limited compared with what we have experienced at other luxury resorts in this category. Given the positioning and pricing of the property, I expected a much wider selection. The food options in general could benefit from more variety.

Overall, Kaldan Samudhra is a beautiful and well-maintained property with a good pool, enjoyable outdoor spaces, excellent high tea, and some genuinely good people providing service. I would recommend the property, but I hope the management takes the feedback seriously, particularly around food variety and consistency. Addressing these areas would make the overall experience much more in line with what guests would expect from a luxury resort.Reviewed August 05, 2026Dear Padmanabhan,
